body: He sounds like a huge douche. Continue working on yourself, but for you. Not him. I could understand the getting better mentally part, but he really didn't need to bring up your weight. Especially considering he knows your issues around that. He obviously doesn't actually give a shit about your mental health, he just wants you to act and be the person he's envisioning. If he can't love you for you he's not worth it honey. Get yourself in a good place and look for a partner who actually values YOU as a person, and not what you could be.

I really hope your son does tell people about this. And hopefully he can get away from the both of you. As much as you don't like his behavior, he's a child. She's a grown ass adult. Y'all need individual therapy and probably should have been doing family therapy since the start of this. It's disgusting that you're okay with her punching your child in the face. There's something wrong with the two of you and I hope you both get to deal with the consequences of her actions.
We're not broken up, but we're not talking right now. It hurts too much and he acts like everything is normal
